description: Disable a language from this brand's publishing set. The brand's default language can never be removed this way — call set_brand_content_language to change the default first (not implemented by this tool). This does not delete any already-published content in that language, only stops it being an enabled target for new work.

language.description: Language to disable, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs.

name: remove_brand_language
